name: ProbateInventories
description: Probate and estate inventories that list the goods of a deceased person with appraised values.

contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: Set to true if the input text contains no probate inventory. Otherwise, set to false.

decedent.description: The name of the deceased person, as written.

decedent_occupation.description: The occupation or status of the deceased person. Use null if not stated.

date.description: The date of the inventory or of the death, as written. Use null if the source gives no date.

place.description: The place where the inventory was taken. Use null if not stated.

currency.description: The currency or monetary unit of the appraised values, as written. Use null if not stated.

items.description: The inventoried goods in the order of the source.

description.description: The good as described in the source. Example: 'one oak table'.

quantity.description: The number of units listed. Use null if not stated.

appraised_value.description: The appraised value of the line as a decimal number. Use null if not stated.

source_page.description: The page or folio on which the inventory begins. Use null if not identifiable.

notes.description: Remarks about the inventory, such as the appraisers or an uncertain reading. Use null if there are none.
